messages.text: Did my order get mailed today

No, Eric, it hasn't shipped yet. Your B30 and Power K. (Shop····) now ship November 15, a week later than the November 7 I gave you last time. Sorry about that.

The Power K. is already set aside for you at our Tennessee warehouse. The B30 is the part still on its way there from the factory. We emailed you about it on November 3, with photos from the factory.

You can follow that shipment to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We'll email you the tracking as soon as it ships.
